module.purpose: Defines the core route types and runtime route classes used to construct, initialize, extend, configure, and identify routes in the router.
module.summary: This module is the central route model for TanStack Router. It combines extensive TypeScript type-level inference for paths, parameters, search schemas, context, loader data, SSR, route matches, and route trees with runtime classes that initialize route identity, normalize paths, attach children, update options, register lazy loaders, and create route-relative redirects or not-found responses.
module.businessContext: Supports application navigation, data loading, route matching, SSR, and error handling. Failures can invalidate route trees, navigation URLs, loader context, and rendered route behavior.
classes: BaseRoute (~L1120-1370): Runtime route object storing identity, hierarchy, options, children, and lazy state.
BaseRouteApi (~L1372-1400): Route-scoped API for not-found responses and redirects.
BaseRootRoute (~L1420-1460): Root-specific runtime route extending the general route implementation.
functions: init (~L1190-1255): Assigns route hierarchy, normalized path, identifier, and full path.
addChildren (~L1257-1275): Adds child routes through the file-child attachment path.
_addFileChildren (~L1277-1310): Stores array or object-valued children on the route.
_addFileTypes (~L1312-1330): Returns the route while preserving file-route type information.
updateLoader (~L1332-1360): Replaces loader options and returns a loader-specialized route.
update (~L1362-1370): Merges mutable route options into the route.
lazy (~L1372-1385): Registers an asynchronous lazy route factory.
redirect (~L1387-1400): Creates a redirect with the current route path as its source.
notFound (~L1408-1415): Creates a route-scoped not-found response.
redirect (~L1417-1425): Creates a route API redirect using the route identifier as source.
systemCapabilities: Attach children and lazy route modules

env: Reads process.env.NODE_ENV to suppress the missing-parent exception in production.
mutationOfArg: Mutates the route instance by assigning identity, hierarchy, children, lazy functions, and options.
Mutates options with Object.assign in updateLoader and update.
